messages:
incident-bot: :warning: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx and timeout rates detected on gateway-pop-prod (nyc). Error spike started ~1767779900. Current p95 latency up 3x, 5xx rate from 0.6% -> 8%. Paging on-call. Link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/edge/nyc-gateway

jamal: I'm on it. Paging rotation: jamal (on-call). Starting triage — gathering spans and recent deploys.

alex: I see increased fanout to model-pool-a, queue depth rising on edge-proxy. Logs show many downstream 502s from inference-runtime at ~1767779850.

maria: Confirmed. A few customers reported aborted requests/retries. Ticket intake: PROD-4521. Customer-impact: intermittent failures for requests > 3s.

sophie: Repro on staging? I just hit a similar pattern by replaying a burst load; the proxy queue pushes requests causing backend connection resets.

jamal: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle ingress at edge for bursts, 2) enable short-circuit fallback to cached responses for probe endpoints, 3) scale up dedicated pool if autoscaler lagging. Doing step 1 now.

alex: Applying temporary rate-limit rule to /v1/generate to 400rps for nyc region via edge-config. Command: ```curl -X POST https://edgeconfig.redwood/api/rate-limit -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","region":"nyc","limit":400}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $EDGE_API'```

devops-bot: Deploy started: edge-config-rollout/2026-06-05T16:14Z by alex. Rollout id: rc-8891.

jamal: Rate-limit applied, seeing immediate drop in downstream queue depth. 5xx rate trending down from 8% -> 3.5% in last 60s. Still watching.

maria: Noting customer-facing message draft for status page, updating: "We are investigating increased errors and timeouts in NYC region, mitigations in progress."

alex: Hotfix candidate for backend: bump keepalive & proxy buffers on inference-runtime workers to reduce connection resets. Patch ready, needs quick approval for canary. Patch: ```sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time=120; sed -i 's/proxy_buffer_size .*;/proxy_buffer_size 8k;/' /etc/nginx/conf.d/proxy.conf; systemctl restart inference-runtime```

jamal: Can we canary to 1 node in pool-b before wider rollout? If successful, push to all.

alex: Canary applied to pool-b-2. Observability: cpu steady, connection resets dropped to near zero for canary. Rolling to pool-b-*.

devops-bot: Canary rollout completed: inference-runtime/patch-keepalive -> 6 nodes.

jamal: 5xx rate now ~0.9% and p95 latency back to baseline. Marking incident as mitigated for now.

product-qe: Noting that reruns of our heavy prompt set still show occasional 504s when concurrency > 120. Might need queue sizing + backpressure in runtime.

maria: Next steps (action items):
- alex: create PR with hotfix and automated kube preroll that updates proxy buffers (PR #3291)
- jamal: update runbook step "throttle-ingress" with concrete curl commands and rollback steps
- sophie: add load test for burst profile to staging to catch before prod
- devops-bot / infra: revisit autoscaler target for inference pools to reduce scale latency
- product-qe: own regression test and add to CI nightly

alex: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3291. Includes config, tests, and rollout job.

jamal: Runbook edits I'm making now. New section: "If 5xx spike from fanout -> immediate ingress throttle (curl snippet), canary kernel/keepalive change, escalate to infra if queue depth doesn't fall in 2 minutes."

maria: Alert tuning: change the 5xx SLO alert to fire only when sustained >2% for 3m AND p95 latency > 2s to reduce noisy pages. Also add a secondary ops-only channel for degraded state (no page).

alex: Note: the temporary rate-limit will remain for 30m then auto-remove (edge-config rollback scheduled) unless we decide to keep.

jamal: Postmortem owners: cause analysis (alex), mitigation timeline (jamal), customer impact summary (maria), follow-up actions (sophie). Meeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC to review RCA and ship runbook + alert PRs.

product-qe: I've captured the failing prompt examples and attached to PROD-4521. Will include scripts for repro.

maria: Status page updated: Investigating -> Mitigated (partial). Will draft final customer note after RCA.

jamal: Closing thread for live mitigation. Reopen if rates spike again. Thanks all for fast response :rocket:
